reviews.text:
We Love Our Pool!
This project, and most, don't go perfect or smooth... But Norma, Alex, Brian, Robert & and Crew, Ferman, Walter, Luis, & Kevin did their best to give us something that feels perfect and looks beautiful!!! I have seen some negative reviews, but in all honesty, the whole team timely responded to any inquiry or concern during the entire pool construction process and delivered what they said they would. This is a very stressful process and can be several months long for the homeowner, depending on a lot of factors, but from breaking ground to swimming, it was 4 weeks, and we had weather issues and a big project. So now we have a beautiful backyard resort along with a forever relationship with a great pool company!
reviews.author: Teresa Wise

reviews.text: Overall a great experience, Norma and Brian are great. They both are attentive and caring. They want to see you get the most out of your pool ownership experience. Service after the sale is taken care of by these two and they answer questions  and respond to calls to address your concerns. Thanks to both of them and hats off to Therman for always showing up.
reviews.author: Herman Ward Jr

reviews.text: This installation simply went great! All the guys from delivery to installation were super nice and professional. The pool was robustly installed. I have no concerns moving forward as the end user. Norma kept the project rolling and the guys working very hard the whole project through. Just a fantastic experience!
reviews.author: Aaron Walters

reviews.text: Pools of Paradise did an amazing job on our pool. Kevin and Brian made sure everything went smoothly, and Norma kept us in the loop throughout the whole process. We’re especially happy with how the concrete turned out. It looks great! Every promise they made was kept, and the whole experience was hassle free. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Justin McGovern

reviews.text: We’re really happy with our experience with Kevin & Inground Pools of Paradise. From the start, Norma kept the communication clear and smooth, which made everything easy. We absolutely love how the pool lights look at night—it’s such a great touch. Plus, they left our yard ready for the landscaping crew, so there was no hassle during the next phase. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Austin Taylor

reviews.text:
Experience was great, have to say that from the first consultative visit to the install everyone was very polite and responsive and respectful. Shout out to the whole crew ( I could name all of you but you know who you are) from the Foreman to everyone else involved, occasional language barrier but didn't get in the way. Even once the pool was in and pump operating the follow up has been real good. Appreciate quick replies from the office with accurate info really made us feel like they cared. Pool school was thorough and professional. The landscaping and irrigation is customer responsibility so just to be mindful of that. The concrete needs attention after the fact and balancing pool chemicals which we are getting but work in progress and we will post a couple photos soon.
Thank you IPP... Anna, TX
reviews.author: Ed A

reviews.text: We are throughly satisfied with our pool and Jacuzzi. Kevin was true to his word throughout our whole experience. We expected the mess, and had no surprises, his staff and contractors walked us right through the mess, to our beautiful oasis. I would highly recommend them to others. My husband still calls Brian with questions and he is so patient with us. Advising us on the workings of our pool. Thank you Kevin, Norma, Brian, and the rest of the team…
reviews.author: robin duncan

reviews.text: Very easy company to work with! Kevin was great to work with and the whole staff was quick to return a call. Brian explained the pool care and equipment in a knowledgeable way and we are loving our new pool! Thanks Kevin and Company
reviews.author: JK Curti
